description: This PHP source file defines the ChannelProjectTransformer class, which extends AbstractTransformer and is used to transform channel project models within the Goteo project. It includes a method to generate delete action URLs based on model properties.

classes.name: ChannelProjectTransformer
classes.description: A class that transforms channel project data, providing actions such as delete based on user permissions and model data.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an array of actions (like delete URL) available for the current user and model context.
